selection: Explicit authored contrasts from complete diagnostic cohorts and sequential-review controls; not exhaustive type annotation.

records.reference: play all songs from blue genre
records.rationale: Blue is explicitly the genre; no additional property beyond genre selection is supplied.

records.reference: play country
records.rationale: Country alone supplies genre, not a separate descriptive property.

records.reference: start playing jazz music
records.rationale: Jazz identifies genre; start playing is an operation, not a music property.

records.reference: play for me hip hop music
records.rationale: Hip hop is genre identity without a separate descriptor.

records.reference: shuffle and play songs from dance genre
records.rationale: Dance is explicitly the genre; shuffle is playback mode rather than a music property.

records.reference: i want to hear the best country songs of the nineties
records.rationale: Best and nineties explicitly constrain quality and era beyond country genre.

records.reference: play some soft jazz
records.rationale: Soft explicitly qualifies the jazz music.

records.reference: i want to find some good rock music
records.rationale: Good explicitly selects musical quality beyond rock genre.

records.reference: christian rock from one thousand nine hundred and ninety upwards only should be selected and played
records.rationale: From one thousand nine hundred and ninety upwards supplies a music-era constraint.

records.reference: please play my favorite pop songs from my list
records.rationale: Favorite explicitly expresses a personal selection property beyond pop genre.

records.reference: download the latest folk songs having rating of four star or above and play all without shuffle
records.rationale: Latest and rating four star or above are explicit recency/quality constraints.

records.reference: play my recently downloaded songs
records.rationale: Recently downloaded identifies music using acquisition history.

records.reference: play some calming music for me
records.rationale: Calming explicitly describes intended musical effect.

records.reference: can you play songs about breakups
records.rationale: About breakups explicitly specifies musical theme.

records.reference: play old fashioned christmas music
records.rationale: Old fashioned Christmas explicitly supplies style-era/occasion descriptors, beyond a bare work or service identity.

records.reference: i would like to listen to some down tempo
records.rationale: Down tempo may be descriptive speed or a genre identity; this wording does not settle the task role.

records.reference: start playing dubstep
records.rationale: Dubstep is a genre identity alone; native descriptor annotation does not establish an additional property.

records.reference: tune song of ddlj movie
records.rationale: Song of ddlj movie may identify a particular track or supply soundtrack association; the fragment does not settle identity versus a separate descriptor.

records.reference: play my itunes music
records.rationale: Itunes music identifies a source/library, not a separate non-genre musical property.

records.reference: show me the best podcast of folk songs having rating of above four star and play it
records.rationale: Best/rating can attach to the podcast rather than the songs; genre exclusion does not resolve attachment.

records.reference: i need you to turn off the light of my bed room
records.rationale: Bedroom only identifies the controlled light location; no independent geographic, event-venue or destination role.

records.reference: mute the living room speakers
records.rationale: Living room identifies speakers being muted, a domestic control scope.

records.reference: vacuum the living room in ten minutes
records.rationale: Living room is the cleaning area; in ten minutes supplies timing, not venue/destination evidence.

records.reference: lights off for the kids bedroom please then change the lights to my room to red
records.rationale: Both bedrooms identify lights for control, not independent event venues.

records.reference: i need to turn on the plug in my office for my computer
records.rationale: Office identifies the controlled plug location; no independent venue or destination role is expressed.

records.reference: please clean the floor
records.rationale: Floor is the domestic cleaning surface, without a geographic or venue role.

records.reference: set a meeting on wednesday at three pm in room
records.rationale: Room is explicitly the venue of the requested meeting; no proper room name is required.

records.reference: remind me at eight am tomorrow that i have a lunch meeting at noon in the conference room
records.rationale: Conference room explicitly locates the represented lunch meeting.

records.reference: have john join me on the tenth at the fifth floor meeting
records.rationale: Fifth floor meeting supplies the venue of the event the recipient should join.

records.reference: i want to listen to npr in the living room
records.rationale: Listening in the living room may specify listening venue or select household playback devices; the utterance does not settle that distinction.

records.reference: i want the ryan seacrest show on the radio in the kitchen
records.rationale: In the kitchen locates the radio selected for playback, a domestic device-location role.

records.reference: broadcast the health show from the kitchen
records.rationale: Broadcast from the kitchen could locate a broadcast event/source or operate a domestic receiver; preserve the role ambiguity.

records.reference: show me the time in new york city
records.rationale: New York City is explicitly a geographic reference for the clock query.

records.reference: any farm markets around with local products
records.rationale: Markets around supplies nearby commercial venues, not household control scope.

records.reference: i went to the park
records.rationale: Park is a venue mention but request relevance of a standalone report remains unresolved; this revision does not change global scope.

admission: Same-author reference proposals; no independent semantic certification or listening; zero admission.
